_about: Defaults and scoring parameters for vnrealty/strategy/. Only conventions and judgement live here — market numbers (rents, ADR, occupancy, prices, growth, rates, hurdle, build cost) are NEVER defaulted: a strategy missing them returns Insufficient naming the keys. Each entry carries `basis`: 'sourced' (a cited document states the number), 'partly_sourced' (a cited document supports part of it, the rest is judgement), or 'judgement' (the desk's prior, to be replaced by evidence). `market_reference` holds cited market ranges for orientation only; the library does not read them as defaults. Rates are fractions, money VND, durations months unless named _years.

loan_ltv.note: convention: unlevered unless the investor states a loan; a positive loan_ltv then requires mortgage_rate

cost_growth.note: VN construction / running-cost inflation (same as plan.options.Lot)

long_lease_rent_factor.note: a long lease trades ~8% of the monthly rent for certainty; used only when long_lease_rent is not given

flip_price_growth.note: a flip is underwritten on the after-repair value, not on market drift

holding_cost_rate.note: per year, share of price: non-agricultural land use tax (0.03-0.15% of the official-table value) + fencing/clearing; conservative against market price

sell_months.note: after the new certificates issue, months to sell all lots; modelled as one sale at the horizon

holding_cost_rate.note: per year, share of price, as land_bank

deposit_months.note: master-lease deposit, months of master rent; 2-3 is common in landlord listings

master_rent_escalation.note: per year; carried by the engine's cost_growth, which also grows staff and other fixed costs

other_running_costs.note: utilities/upkeep the operator pays beyond the master rent; pass a real number

ota_commission.note: Booking.com from 15% (≈18% with Preferred Partner); Airbnb host-only fee ~15%. Carried as `management`

liquidity_months._basis: judgement: months to turn the position back into cash at a fair price, from the decision to exit

complexity._basis: judgement: execution difficulty 1 (passive) .. 5 (hard, many failure points)

bear_overrides._basis: judgement: extra shock merged into ev.default_scenarios' bear scenario for strategies whose value is mostly the resale

score_weights._basis: judgement: score = w_eff·E[NPV]/K − w_bear·max(0,−bear NPV)/K − w_ploss·P(loss) − w_liq·liquidity_months/12 − w_cx·(complexity−1)/4, K = peak cash

tach_thua_da_nang.rule: Quyết định 75/2026/QĐ-UBND (effective 10/6/2026) Điều 6 khoản 1 sets the minimum residential area and side per ward in Phụ lục III — the per-ward table was NOT read, so no per-ward minimum is recorded. Khoản 2 (land inside a planned recovery/conversion area whose plan lapsed): 100 m² / side 5.0 m where the khoản-1 minimum is ≤ 60 m²; 150 m² / 5.0 m where it is 70-80 m²; 200 m² / 6.0 m elsewhere.
tach_thua_da_nang.use: strategy subdivide REQUIRES `min_lot_m2` for the parcel's ward (read Phụ lục III or ask the land office); it is never defaulted. Also subject to Nghị quyết 254/2025/QH15 Điều 11 khoản 3 and roads/infrastructure obligations for lots created for sale.
